items.title: Ford blasts Duffy criticism of China tech partners, calls letter 'wrongheaded'
items.summary: Ford stock was volatile a day after the White House questioned its strategy of using Chinese partners. Ford responded after the bell in a forceful manner, hinting as possible behind-the-scenes drama.

items.title: Ford rebuffs Transportation Secretary's criticisms of Chinese partnerships
items.summary: Ford (F) fires back at the Trump administration's criticisms of the US automaker using Chinese partners for technology in its battery plant project. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian explains US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy's letter to Ford leadership, the car company's response, and its plans for a Michigan battery plant.

items.title: Ford to invest $1B in Kentucky plant that makes key trucks, SUVs
items.summary: Ford will invest $1 billion in its Kentucky Truck Plant, which is on top of the $2 billion the automaker has invested in Louisville Assembly Plant.

items.title: Ford Fires Back at Trump's Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy Over China Ties: 'Wrongheaded Attempt to Capture Headlines'
items.summary: Ford Motor Co drew sharp criticism on Tuesday from President Donald Trump‘s Transportation Secretary, Sean Duffy, who warned that the automaker’s work with several China-linked companies could create U.S. security risks. Trump Admin Slams Ford According to a report by...

items.title: Ford invests $1 billion in Kentucky Truck Plant paint shop
items.summary: The new paint shop will replace the existing facility at Kentucky Truck Plant, Ford's largest and highest-revenue U.S. manufacturing plant

items.title: China’s Auto Threat Isn’t Just About EVs. Tesla Is Caught in the Middle.
items.summary: It’s about China and its plans to dominate the global auto market.  On Wednesday, Michigan Sen. Elissa Slotkin shot off a series of tweets on X, suggesting President Donald Trump might allow Chinese cars to be sold in America.  The White House didn’t respond to a request for comment.

items.title: Can Ford Overcome Tariff and Commodity Cost Headwinds in 2026?
items.summary: F raises its 2026 EBIT guidance despite tariff and commodity headwinds, while a Novelis aluminum recovery can drive a major second-half benefit.

items.title: Why Are Ford's China Partnerships Drawing Regulatory Scrutiny?
items.summary: F faces U.S. scrutiny over CATL and Geely ties, as regulators examine whether its partnerships could deepen reliance on Chinese state-backed firms.
